name: readable-config-values
goal: Keep config values compact and inspect full declarations without page overflow

evidence: Configs renders complete multiline schema expressions inline, making rows excessively tall and clipping long lines. Compact preview plus complete-value inspection should retain exact source values and revision links.

Existing entity-preview-groups configVariables covers only scalar values, filtering and historical pageSize. Extend its shared configSnapshot fixture with multiline expressions and long strings; assert compact row geometry, full-value modal, keyboard close and revision isolation at each standard viewport.
Retained red 1bcaed51a: all three existing category-folder cases fail long values stay compact at schema rows of 234-242px. Same checkpoint captured and retained before assertion.

Opus 5.5 implemented two-line expression previews, counts, shared HarnessAction and read-only Modal; exact values, revision links and focus restoration retained. Reviewed all assigned edits; only ExplorerTable product source changed.
